decision_conditions: Prior to the first occupation of any of the commercial units hereby approved, adetailed Parking Management Plan for the site shall be submitted to and approved inwriting by the Local Planning Authority. The Plan shall specify, but not be limited to:1. The designation and operational management of all on-site parking spaces, includingthe 36 car parking spaces, disabled persons' parking bays, and electric vehiclecharging points.2. The means by which the parking associated with the adjacent commercial units willcontinue to be managed and relocated to ensure no net loss in parking or overspillonto the local highway network.3. The methods of enforcement and monitoring to ensure the car parking provision isused and retained exclusively for its designated purpose.The approved Parking Management Plan shall be implemented prior to the firstoccupation of the development and shall be adhered to and retained for the lifetime of thedevelopment.Reason: To ensure the parking provision is appropriately managed, does not result in aloss of existing parking, and to comply with Policy 37 of the Sutton Local Plan.

Prior to the first occupation of any of the commercial units hereby approved, adetailed  shall be submitted to and approved in writing by theLocal Planning Authority. The Plan shall set out how all deliveries and servicingoperations will be managed and shall include, but not be limited to:1. Full details of the designated on-site loading and unloading areas, access, andegress routes for all service and delivery vehicles.2. Measures to ensure that all vehicles can be accommodated within the site and do notqueue or wait on the public highway.3. Specific measures to manage the servicing and deliveries, such as noise mitigationmeasures and ways to prevent increased road traffic.4. Details of any consolidation of deliveries and the promotion of low or zero-emissionvehicles where feasible.5. The process for waste management, storage, transfer, and collection on site.6. A clear process for long-term review and update of the plan to reflect operationalchanges.The approved Servicing and Delivery Plan shall be implemented prior to the firstoccupation of the development and shall be adhered to and retained for the lifetime of thedevelopment.Reason: To ensure that the delivery and servicing of the site does not cause congestion,inconvenience, or safety issues on the local highway network, and to promote sustainabletransport measures in accordance with Policies 29 and 36 of the Sutton Local Plan.
